## description

please describe the experience! e.g. "the game crashes during bootup", "the game gets to the title screen but crashes on New Game", "the game gets to gameplay but the main character is invisible", ...

## details

please fill the **blank cells** of the following table! e.g. for Void Terrarium, `| game id | PPSA02929 |  |` becomes `| game id | PPSA02929 | PPSA03061 |`.

| | example | yours |
|-|-|-|
| game id | PPSA02929 |  |
| game version | 01.000.000 |  |
| device | AYN Odin 3 |  |
| SoC | Snapdragon 8 Elite |  |
| sharpdroid version | 3 |  |
| SharpEmu build | Bundled build |  |
| graphics driver | System driver |  |

## screenshots

feel free to share one or multiple screenshots of the game running under sharpdroid! you dont have to, of course.
